income_stability.label: Income Stability
income_stability.measures: Employment stability using employment history as a proxy; monthly income history is not available in this prototype.
income_stability.methodology_note: Employment tenure is a prototype proxy, not a longitudinal measure of income.

cashflow_stability.label: Cash-flow Stability
cashflow_stability.measures: Cash-flow variability, negative months, and minimum monthly cash flow.
cashflow_stability.methodology_note: Combines cash-flow variability (50%), negative months (30%), and minimum cash flow relative to income (20%).

payment_discipline.label: Payment Discipline
payment_discipline.measures: On-time repayments, payment coverage, and payment timing.
payment_discipline.methodology_note: Combines on-time payments (50%), payment coverage (30%), and payment delay (20%).

savings_discipline.label: Savings Discipline
savings_discipline.measures: Monthly savings behaviour relative to income.
savings_discipline.methodology_note: 20% is the prototype savings-rate benchmark, not a universal financial standard.

commitment_adherence.label: Commitment Adherence
commitment_adherence.measures: Insurance payment consistency and repayment coverage.
commitment_adherence.methodology_note: Combines insurance payment consistency (70%) and payment coverage (30%); utility-payment history is not assumed.

debt_burden.label: Debt Burden
debt_burden.measures: Current repayment burden and credit debt relative to annual income.
debt_burden.methodology_note: Current repayment burden and credit exposure use 70% and 30% weights. Lower burden produces a higher score.

financial_stress.label: Financial Stress
financial_stress.measures: Expense pressure, negative cash-flow months, overdue behaviour, and savings buffer.
financial_stress.methodology_note: Lower current financial pressure produces a higher score.

financial_resilience.label: Financial Resilience
financial_resilience.measures: Savings buffer, investment participation, and minimum cash-flow strength.
financial_resilience.methodology_note: The savings buffer uses a six-month prototype benchmark; investment participation counts six product types and caps at three.
